_doc: scripts/arch-check configuration: the machine form of docs/ENGINEERING.md §2 (layers) and §3 (budgets). Changing a budget or a layer is a rule change (docs/ENGINEERING.md, DECISIONS.md), not a fix. Each layer's `order` lists its crates (after layer_overrides) bottom first: a same-layer dependency a -> b is allowed only when b comes before a (K87, K-2; acyclic by construction).

_exceptions_doc: Named exceptions approved by Arkin (DECISIONS K85; reasons in rounds/RG1/REPORT.md §4). A finding matching rule+item is printed as an exception on every run instead of failing. `max` is a latch (K89): a value above it fails; a crate.lines exception must carry one; it may only go down except by a decision row. Adding or removing one needs a decision row.
